an1.11:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi yena anuppanno vā kāmacchando uppajjati uppanno vā kāmacchando bhiyyo bhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave subha-nimittaṃ.
an1.11:1.2: Subha-nimittaṃ bhikkhave ayoniso manasikaroto anuppanno c' eva kāmacchando uppajjati uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyo bhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatī
an1.12:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi yena anuppanno vā vyāpādo uppajjati uppanno vā vyāpādo bhiyyo bhāvāya veppullāya saṃvattati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave paṭigha-nimittaṃ.
an1.12:1.2: Paṭighanimittaṃ bhikkhave ayoniso manasikaroto anuppanno c' eva vyāpādo uppajjati uppanno ca vyāpādo bhiyyo bhāvaya vepullāya saṃvattatī
an1.13:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā thīna-middhaṃ uppajjati uppannaṃ vā thīnamiddhaṃ bhiyyo bhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave aratī-tandīvijambhikā bhatta-sammado cetaso ca līnattam.
an1.13:1.2: Līnacittassa bhikkhave anuppannaṃ c' eva thīnamiddhaṃ uppajjati uppannañ ca thīnamiddhaṃ bhiyyo bhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatī
an1.14:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā uddhacca-kukkuccaṃ uppajjati uppannaṃ vā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyo bhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave cetaso avūpasamo.
an1.14:1.2: Avūpasanta-cittassa bhikkhave anuppannaṃ c' eva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati uppannañ ca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyo bhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatī
an1.15:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannā vā vicikicchā uppajjati uppannā vā vicikicchā bhiyyo bhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave ayoniso manasikāro.
an1.15:1.2: Ayoniso bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppannā c' eva vicikicchā uppajjati uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyo bhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatī
an1.16:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi yena anuppanno vā kāmacchando n' uppajjati uppanno vā kāmacchando pahīyati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave asubhanimittaṃ.
an1.16:1.2: Asubhanimittaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikaroto anuppanno c' eva kāmacchando n' uppajjati uppanno ca kāmacchando pahīyatī
an1.17:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi yena anuppanno vā vyāpādo n' uppajjati uppanno vā vyāpādo pahīyati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave mettā cetovimutti.
an1.17:1.2: Mettaṃ bhikkhave ceto-vimuttiṃ yoniso manasikaroto anuppanno c' eva vyāpādo n' uppajjati uppanno ca vyāpādo pahīyatī
an1.18:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā thīna-middhaṃ n' uppajjati uppannaṃ vā thīna-middhaṃ pahīyati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave ārambha-dhātu nikkama-dhātu parakkama-dhātu.
an1.18:1.2: Āraddha-viriyassa bhikkhave anuppannaṃ c' eva thīnamiddhaṃ n' uppajjati uppannañ ca thīnamiddhaṃ pahīyatī
an1.19:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā uddhacca-kukkuccaṃ n' uppajjati uppannaṃ vā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīyati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave cetaso vūpasamo.
an1.19:1.2: Vūpasanta-cittassa bhikkhave anuppannaṃ c' eva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ n' uppajjati uppannañ ca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīyatī
an1.20:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannā vā vicikicchā n' uppajjati uppannā vā vicikicchā pahīyati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikāro.
an1.20:1.2: Yoniso bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppannā c' eva vicikicchā n' uppajjati uppannā ca vicikicchā pahīyatī
